انشغلوا (form VII)
# اِنْشَغَلُوا (inšaḡalū) /in.ʃa.ɣa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْشَغَلَ (inšaḡala)
# اِنْشَغِلُوا (inšaḡilū) /in.ʃa.ɣi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْشَغَلَ (inšaḡala)
